suite.doc: Dual-stack tenants over the same SRv6 core: every tenant site also has an IPv6 attachment circuit (fd00:16/18:n::/64) and LAN (fd00:20/21:n::/64), an IPv6 eBGP session per VRF, VPNv6 to both reflectors, and ONE End.DT46 SID per VRF that decapsulates both families.
